description: Change a library entry (by id or slug). published:true (make public) and ANY change to an already public entry are parked for approval and run only when a human admin approves them: in the app (Freigaben), or on that human's explicit request via resolve_pending_tool_call {human_request} with their own API key (never as an agent). published:false (withdraw) takes effect immediately. status internal = team only: withdraws a public entry at once and blocks publishing until set back to draft. youtube_url_de/youtube_url_en store a YouTube link. Never deletes.

duration_de_s.description: Length of the German version in seconds

duration_en_s.description: Length of the English version in seconds

id.description: ID of the library video to change

industry.description: Industry, e.g. Handwerk, Industrie, Großhandel, Dienstleistung.

notes.description: Internal notes, never shown publicly (e.g. how the video was made: sources, script, voice, build command). An entry with notes cannot be published.

published.description: true makes it public (needs admin approval); false withdraws it immediately

slug.description: URL name of the entry (alternative to id)

sort.description: Order on the page (lower first), default 100.

status.description: internal: team only, never public; archived hides the entry (not deleted)

system.description: Connected system: sap, salesforce, hubspot, pipedrive, odoo, weclapp, business-central, mail, other

youtube_url_de.description: YouTube link of the German version

youtube_url_en.description: YouTube link of the English version

name: update_library_video
